thread:
Alex (Sales): ok team, Solstice Health wants a short POC. Goal: 95th <220ms for chat at 2k rps + 6k embeddings (mixed). Need runbook, perf numbers, and pricing delta for dedicated vs hosted. Can we scope this?
Priya (Eng): got it. can you confirm avg prompt/response sizes and embedding dims? also any PII requirements?
Alex (Sales): avg prompt ~120 tokens, avg response ~180 tokens. embeddings are 384-d, typically batched at 32. they said PHI is possible -> customer will ask about KMS.
Sam (SRE): plan: two-phase test. phase A: chat-only steady-state for 15m at 2k rps. phase B: mixed ramp up to 10k rps with 75% embedding calls. Using k6 to drive both. Example snippet: 
```js
import http from 'k6/http';
import { sleep } from 'k6';
export default function() {
  const payload = JSON.stringify({model: "redwood-chat-4r", input: "<120 tokens>"});
  http.post('https://api.redwood.redwood-inference/v1/generate', payload, {headers:{'Authorization':'Bearer $TOKEN'}});
  sleep(0.01);
}
```
Sam (SRE): infra sim: dedicated pool 4xA100 equiv, target concurrency ~8k (to get 9-10k rps peak). will enable continuous batching, prefix caching off for baseline.
Ryan (Eng): add KV prefix caching for chat in a second run — we expect ~15-20% token reduction and lower tail. Also recommend using q4f16 for embeddings to reduce memory pressure (small latency tradeoff).
Priya (Eng): noted. quantization can add ~10-20ms to median but reduces OOM risk on mixed runs. we'll include both configs in the report.
Alex (Sales): customer asked pricing delta: hosted vs dedicated reserved at expected load. need ballpark per-1M token.
Sam (SRE): quick back-of-envelope: hosted ~ $0.08 per 1k chat tokens at this model; dedicated amortized ~ $0.05 per 1k with a 12mo commit at their projected throughput. with replica uplift for burst add ~25% infra cost. spreadsheet: https://internal.sheets/solstice/poc-costs (will share)
Sam (SRE): ran baseline at 1998765500. phase A (chat-only 2k rps steady): 95th = 180ms, p99 = 310ms. phase B mixed ramp started 1998765580 peaked 9.1k rps: chat 95th = 240ms, embeddings 95th = 110ms.
Priya (Eng): chat 95th slipped above 220ms during embedding saturation windows. root cause: GPU memory pressure causing intermittent queueing and increased preempt times.
Priya (Eng): mitigation options: a) enable prefix KV cache (reduces tokenization work), b) increase replicas 4->6, c) separate embedding-only pool (best isolation). I'll annotate tradeoffs in the writeup.
Alex (Sales): can we quantify cost impact if we go +2 replicas vs separate embedding pool? need numbers for customer ASAP.
Sam (SRE): +2 replicas ~= +28% infra cost. separate embedding pool adds fixed infra + management overhead but improves chat 95th reliably. with caching + q4 quant, net per-1M token moves from hosted $80 -> dedicated $60 -> with config changes ~$65. will add exact calcs to sheet.
Ryan (Eng): I'll produce a one-pager: summary, heatmap, config options, perf numbers, and recommended next steps. will attach annotated heatmap and test artifacts. ETA: EOD. :thumbsup:
loadbot: load test artifacts available: https://artifacts.internal/solstice/1998765432/heatmap.png and logs at /artifacts/1998765432/logs.tar.gz
Alex (Sales): perfect. i'll sync with Solstice at 14:00 PT and present the 3 options (cache + quant, +replicas, embedding pool).
Priya (Eng): blocker: Solstice requires customer-managed KMS and FIPS endpoints for production. private deployment supports KMS; dedicated needs peering and a short security review (2 weeks). flagging to AE and CSM.
Alex (Sales): thanks — i've looped in the AE. keeping customer informed on the timeline and cost tradeoffs.
Sam (SRE): next step: run a follow-up mixed test with KV cache + q4 quant and separate embedding pool sim next sprint. i'll schedule and post results.
Ryan (Eng): drafting the one-pager now, will @mention you both when done.
Alex (Sales): great team, thanks!
